description: This file contains the implementation of the RedisReminderTable class, which manages reminder entries stored in Redis for Orleans grains. It includes methods for initializing the table, reading, updating, and deleting reminder entries, as well as internal utilities for serialization and filtering.

classes.name: RedisReminderTable
classes.description: A class implementing the IReminderTable interface, managing reminder entries in Redis with methods for CRUD operations, initialization, and internal serialization utilities.

methods.name: RedisReminderTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the RedisReminderTable with dependencies and setting up the Redis key.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and sets expiry if configured.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a single reminder entry for a specific grain and reminder name.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads all reminder entries for a specific grain.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a specified range of begin and end values.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a specific reminder entry based on grain, reminder name, and eTag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the entire reminder table in Redis (for testing purposes).

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in Redis using a Lua script.

methods.name: ConvertToEntry
methods.description: Converts a serialized string from Redis into a ReminderEntry object.

methods.name: GetFilter
methods.description: Generates Redis key range filters based on grain hash, grain id, reminder name, and eTag.

methods.name: ConvertFromEntry
methods.description: Serializes a ReminderEntry into a string and generates a new eTag.

methods.name: LogDebugUpsertRow
methods.description: Logs debug information for the UpsertRow operation.
